n: 24 Inch 48 Dba Front Control Dishwasher With Quadwash™ And 3rd Rack
desc: Fit more dishes in every load and be confident they’ll come out sparkling. LG's QuadWash four powerful spray arms clean from multiple angles to get dishes clean the first time—without extra rinsing or scrubbing and Dynamic Dry provides ultimate drying performance for the finishing touch of shine.
hl: Get a Spotless Clean the First Time
LG’s exclusive QuadWash® technology gets dishes clean the first time.
Resists Smudges for an Effortless Shine
PrintProof™ finish resists fingerprints and smudges to keep your kitchen looking its best.
An advanced 3-stage filtration system traps food particles to reduce noise & increase efficiency.
Beautiful tables start with beautiful dishes
Dynamic Dry™ technology on all LG dishwashers delivers faster, more complete drying.
Download new cycles from your phone to your dishwasher
With NFC Tag-On, you can do one-touch cycles or your troubleshooting questions right on your phone.
A Convenient Spot for Hard-to-Fit Items
The convenient 3rd rack holds more items so you can save time and wash fewer loads.
